AI 是什么？认识一种新工具: What is AI? Meet a new tool
从聊天、画画和认图片认识 AI，再练习提问、核查和保护隐私。: Meet AI through chat, pictures and recognition, then practice requests, checking and privacy.
手机里有个工具：你给它一句话，它能回话、给点子，有的还能画画或认图片。它叫 AI: Some tools on a phone can reply to words or suggest ideas, and some can draw or identify things in pictures. They are called AI. They can help, but an answer that sounds true can still be wrong.
计算机里的工具，怎样与我们一起完成任务？: How can computer tools help us work on a task?
本页只有预写的本地示例，不是真实在线 AI。没有输入框，不会发送你的问题或照片。: This page uses local prewritten examples, not real online AI. There are no input fields, and it sends no questions or photos.
先看：AI 能帮什么？: First look: what can AI help with?
给它一个任务，再看它给出的东西。不同 AI 工具能做的事并不一样。: Give a tool a task, then examine its output. Different AI tools can do different things.
深入看：这是怎样的工具？: A closer look: what kind of tool is it?
AI 是一类由人设计的计算机系统。这里认识的是能处理文字或图片、给出建议或内容的: AI is a category of computer systems designed by people. Here we meet tools that process text or images and provide suggestions or content, rather than a complete list of AI. One answer does not establish an understanding of the whole world, or the information, permission or ability to complete other tasks.
把任务、背景和想要的形式说清楚，通常更容易得到有用的帮助。好问题仍不能保证答案正: A clear task, context and requested format can make help more useful. A good question still does not guarantee a correct answer; people need to choose, check and edit the output.
AI、程序、机器人和人，是一回事吗？: Are AI, programs, robots and people the same?
选一个看看。它们可以一起工作，但角色不同。: Select one to explore. They can work together, with different roles.
深入看：它们会重叠吗？: A closer look: can the categories overlap?
会。AI 工具也由程序实现，不是程序的反面。“普通程序”在这里指按明确规则处理任: Yes. AI tools are implemented with programs, rather than being the opposite of programs. “Ordinary program” here means a familiar example with explicit task rules, not a strict software classification. A robot has a mechanical body that acts in the physical world; it may follow fixed programs or use AI. A chat tool without a mechanical body can be AI too.
会用“我”、会写安慰的话，不等于它和人一样有感受或承担责任。人的观察、关系、判断: Using “I” or writing comforting words does not establish feelings or responsibility like a person’s. A talking tool cannot replace all human observation, relationships, judgment and care.
这一次，先做哪件事？: What should I do first this time?
不是猜“AI 永远能不能做”，而是为眼前的任务选一个合适的起点。: Choose a suitable starting point for this particular task, rather than guessing what AI always can or cannot do.
先观察或问大人: Start by observing or asking an adult
说得很肯定，就能相信吗？: Does a confident answer make it true?
下面的回答全是我们写的练习。先找证据，再决定这句话能不能用。: We wrote all the answers below for this activity. Look for evidence before deciding whether to use a claim.
请大人查正式通知: Ask an adult to check official notices
答案可能正确、错误，也可能现在没有足够信息。拿不准时可以停下来；再问同一个工具一: An answer may be correct, incorrect or lacking information. You can pause when unsure; asking the same tool again does not supply independent evidence.
把工具用在合适的地方: Use a tool where it fits
先说任务，留住自己的判断: State the task and keep your own judgment
“给我三个故事开头，句子短一点。”告诉它任务和形式，再挑选、修改。你还是作品的主: “Give me three story openings with short sentences.” State the task and format, then choose and edit. The work is still yours.
观察实物、翻可靠资料、请大人一起确认。题目重要时，不能只凭一个 AI 回答作决定: Observe real objects, read reliable sources and check with an adult. Important decisions need more than a single AI answer.
练习提问不需要真实姓名、家里地址、密码或同学照片。使用真实服务前，和大人一起看年: Practicing requests does not need real names, home addresses, passwords or classmates’ photos. Check age requirements and privacy settings with an adult before using a real service.
AI 可以帮你想一句问候。想知道朋友的想法，还要认真听朋友说；需要帮助时，找信任: AI can suggest a greeting. To understand a friend, listen carefully to the friend; when you need help, talk to a trusted adult.
给家长的深入说明与模型边界: Further explanation and activity limits for adults
本页围绕工具类别、用途与判断来建立 AI 素养，不模拟学习过程，也不把聊天式 A: This page builds AI literacy through categories, uses and judgment. It does not simulate learning or equate conversational tools with all AI. Results are editorial teaching examples and cannot measure any real model’s ability, accuracy or safety. No actual image recognition or generation runs on this page.
生活任务的推荐起点由情境决定，不是“AI 可用/禁用”清单。AI 可辅助查找或整: Recommended starting points depend on the situation, rather than forming an allowed/forbidden AI list. AI may help find or organize information, but sources still need checking. This page accepts, stores and uploads no children’s personal details; a guardian needs to check each real product’s data practices and age rules.
